# Meridian Dispute Resolution Inc.

> Meridian Dispute Resolution is a Saskatchewan-based mediation practice offering neutral, structured mediation for family, estate, workplace, business, and community disputes. Available virtually and in person across Canada.

## Pages

- [Home](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/): Overview of Meridian's mediation services and approach.
- [About](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/about.html): Background on founder and mediator Mabel Adekola.
- [How We Help](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/services.html): Practice areas — family and separation, estate and elder, workplace, business and commercial, and neighbour and community mediation.
- [How Mediation Works](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/the-process.html): The four-step mediation process, from initial consultation through agreement.
- [FAQs](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/faq.html): Answers to common questions about cost, confidentiality, and process.
- [Contact](https://meridiandisputeresolution.ca/contact.html): Schedule a free 30-minute consultation.

## Details

- Rate: $150 CAD/hour
- Free 30-minute initial consultation, no obligation to proceed
- Service area: Saskatchewan, with virtual mediation available across Canada
- Mediator holds a Qualified Mediator designation recognized by the ADR Institute of Canada (ADRIC)
